notes.title: Major Update 0.5!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45177094/f6ec9d9a41c50a5bf27638e13613f6154e2f02bb.png[/img]




[previewyoutube=w-lG3jsBIeE;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]











[b]Patch Notes May 7, 2025[/b]

[b]Ghost[/b]
-Ghost are broken down into four classes.  (Sight, Hearing, Wander and Smell)
-Each Ghost also has an individual behavior which can be shared with another ghost in another class.
-Ghost books are now located in every map.  Catch the ghost then located the book to unlock information in your ghost journal. 
-new death effect has been added
-Rare ghost spawn added.  Only available on Hunter or Higher Difficulty 

[b]Defensive Items[/b]
-New Ghost Mine has been added to the game.  Comes with one charge 
but can be upgraded with skill points.

[b]Skill Points[/b]
-now located in afterlife shop you can purchase perks with skill points.   
-Weekly Objective has been added.  Each week you can earn a skill point completing it. 
-Prestige will award 2 skill points each time

[b]Voice Chat[/b]
-Voice Chat has been improved.  Proximity and Radio chat are now live.

[b]Steam Achievements[/b]
-achievements have been added and are now live with this update.

[b]What's Next[/b]
-More Maps
-More Playable Characters
-Secret Rooms and more achievements

This is our biggest update yet and more to come!  Find us on discord for the latest news and answers to any questions you may have.

notes.title: Patch Notes November 21, 2024
notes.content:
This will be the last minor patch before our first major update.   This patch includes

-Sage has been moved to the top of the store and a buy all button has been added.
-The ghost behavior is greatly improved.   You can now hide from the ghost.
-Mission Results have been added when returning to the clubhouse.
-Gamma has been added to the video options menu
-Ghost Alarm has been added.  Good for one use per round.   You will find it in the trailer.
-Improved lighting 
-fixed ghost not drawing or drawing too much power off equipment.  
-fix issues with trap not firing when ghost was smudged.   
-some performance issues have been fixed as well as some other minor fixes.

Now that we cleaned up most of the issues since we launched, we are going to focus on the upcoming major update.   More maps as well as tier 2 gear are coming very soon.  We are a small team of 3 and we appreciate your support and patience with us.  Thank You
